alt: 明明花瓶完好無缺，一個人卻隨口把它說成破損的壞作品，旁人拿著實物核對，發現他的批評不實。
scene_prompt: 信口雌黃 means casually distorting facts and criticizing without basis. Modern craft exhibition. A smug adult critic carelessly points at an obviously PERFECTLY INTACT handmade ceramic vase with no crack, while his picture-only speech bubble falsely depicts that same vase badly cracked and broken. Another adult beside the display lifts the actual unbroken vase to show the false claim, looking doubtful at the critic. The critic gestures dismissively without examining the object, emphasizing reckless baseless criticism rather than an honest mistaken observation. Original generic floral ceramic, no known artist designs, writing, letter labels, signatures or text.
